dialogue.oririmod.dungeon_keeper.name: Dungeon Keeper
dialogue.oririmod.dungeon_keeper.greetin: Ah, Another Brave Soul Ventures Forth. What Do You Need, Adventurer? The Dungeons Await Those Who Dare to Face Them.
dialogue.oririmod.dungeon_keeper.choice_: I Want to Go on a Dungeon Quest.
dialogue.oririmod.dungeon_keeper.lore_1: Me? I Am the Dungeon Keeper. I Have Watched Over These Ancient Passages for Longer Than Most Kingdoms Have Stood.
dialogue.oririmod.dungeon_keeper.lore_2: These Dungeons Were Not Built by Mortal Hands. They Were Carved by Forces Older Than Memory Itself — Labyrinthine Chambers Filled with Forgotten Treasures and Creatures That Should Have Never Existed.
dialogue.oririmod.dungeon_keeper.lore_3: But Enough About the Past. If You Seek Glory, Power, or Simply the Thrill of Survival — You've Come to the Right Place. Now Then, What Will It Be?
dialogue.oririmod.dungeon_keeper.goodbye: Very Well. Return When You Are Ready, Adventurer. The Dungeons Are Patient... But Their Inhabitants Are Not.
